description_en: Re-evaluates resources that are evaluated based on a rule after the evaluation results on some resources of an ignored rule in an account group are resumed
description_zh: 恢复已忽略账号组内某条规则对某些资源的评估结果后，继续显示该规则对资源的评估结果
kebab_example: aliyun config revert-aggregate-evaluation-results --config-rule-id cr-7e72626622af00510000 --resources ResourceId=lb-hp3a3b4ztyfm2plgm0000 Region=cn-beijing ResourceType=ACS::SLB::LoadBalancer ResourceAccountId=1208863178610000 --aggregator-id ca-5b6c626622af008f0000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevertAggregateEvaluationResults
